content:
maria: Heads-up — canary for release 4f3b8d7 merged at 08:58 UTC is showing a decode p95 spike on short-seq traffic (<=32). Noticed ~2.3x p95 and KV hit rate dropped. CI perf job decode-p95 also failed: https://ci.internal/reports/4f3b8d7/decode-p95 :face_with_monocle:
ryan: on it. which hosts / canary group?
maria: us-west-2 canary group A (10 hosts). Quick snapshot:
```
baseline p95: 45ms -> canary p95: 110ms
kv_cache_hit: 87% -> 60%
workload: short-seq chat toy prompts
metrics: token throughput similar, tail latency up
```
kai: that commit 4f3b8d7 touched the fused-op scheduler and the batching heuristics — I think it lowered the per-shard queue_limit default from 2048 -> 512 and enabled aggressive kv-eviction when backlog > threshold.
ryan: that matches. my quick profile shows more small batches and a lot of attention kernel switches. Could be kernel selector thrash + kv misses.
perf-bot: CI perf test decode-p95 FAILED on 1768123456 (replicate script exit 1)
ryan: can someone run a local bisect? I want confirmation it's 4f3b8d7 and not a downstream kernel change.
kai: starting a bisect now — command I used:
```
git bisect start HEAD v4.3.1
git bisect run ./scripts/perf/run_decode_p95.sh --shortseq
```
ryan: any early results?
kai: bisect pointed to 4f3b8d7 -> change in scheduler/batcher.cc around the queue_limit and batch fragmentation heuristic. Reverted locally and p95 back to baseline: 48ms.
maria: sweet. Can confirm setting RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy on canary hosts drops p95 to ~50-55ms. Quick repro steps we used:
```
# on canary host
export RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy
systemctl restart redwood-runtime
run ./scripts/perf/run_decode_p95.sh --shortseq
# p95 -> ~50ms
```
jen: hold the rollout for that merge. This is a rollout-blocker if short-seq apps are affected.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for release/4f3b8d7 has been PAUSED by @jen — reason: decode p95 regression (short-seq).
ryan: options:
- revert 4f3b8d7 entirely (fast)
- patch: restore queue_limit to 2048 but keep other fixes, and add knob to kernel selector to stabilize on small batches
- deploy runtime flag RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy as temporary mitigation (low blast radius)
kai: patch idea: change batching heuristic to avoid fragmenting batches for sequences <= 32, and reduce early kv-eviction aggressiveness (increase eviction threshold by 2x). I can prototype and bench.
maria: we should also run end-to-end perf with real prefix-cached traces (cache hit variations) — current CI perf harness doesn't simulate degraded cache warmup. I'll open an enhancement ticket after triage.
ryan: I'll prepare a revert PR first (hot path), and Kai can follow with a targeted patch. If revert is approved we can unpause rollout once canary metrics return to baseline.
jen: assign owners and ETA?
ryan: revert PR in flight -> #PR-4892, tagging @kai for follow-up patch. ETA for revert review: ~30m.
kai: I'll start the patch branch now and run perf runs locally. If I can produce a patch with p95 parity, we can replace the revert.
maria: add to incident notes: collect perf traces, nvprof flame samples, and KV eviction counters for canary window 08:50-09:30 UTC.
perf-bot: Collected run artifacts: s3://perf-archive/1768123456/canary-traces.tar.gz
ryan: thanks. summary action items:
- [ryan] open revert PR and request quick review (in progress)
- [kai] prototype batching heuristic + kv threshold patch (WIP)
- [maria] collect perf traces + validate mitigation RW_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy across canary hosts
- [jen] hold rollout and notify affected customers if widened
maria: noted — will post another update in 30m with canary metrics after revert or flag rollout. :thumbsup:
